name: merxet
description: Prepare and track browser-approved Merxet orders on Hedera testnet.
long_description: Merxet prepares an order quote from a Merxet catalogue and returns a browser link where the shopper reviews and approves the transaction. The extension cannot access wallet keys, unlock a wallet, sign a transaction, or approve payment.

tools.name: create_merxet_order
tools.description: Create a Merxet testnet quote and return a browser-wallet approval URL.

tools.name: get_merxet_order_status
tools.description: Check settlement evidence and status for an existing Merxet testnet order intent.
